name: Can a broken window seal be repaired, or do I need a new window?

mainEntity.name: Can a broken window seal be repaired, or do I need a new window?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, only the insulated glass unit (IGU) with the broken seal needs to be replaced, not the entire window frame. This process involves removing the old glass unit and installing a new one within the existing frame, which is typically more cost-effective and less disruptive than full window replacement. However, if the window frame itself is damaged or outdated, a full replacement might be recommended for long-term performance and energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typically, only the insulated glass unit needs replacement, not the entire window. A full window replacement is only necessary if the frame is also damaged.
